integrity: Exact formulas proved by orthogonal kernel and quadratic lattice sum; infinite phase extremes proved by irrational equidistribution. Finite tests are corroboration only.
scientific_limitations: Sharp only for evaluation at a sampled endpoint of unweighted degree-two equispaced regression; not the full operator norm or arbitrary-node result. Priority is not independently certified.
title: Arithmetic lattice phases in the boundary sensitivity of quadratic discrete least squares
